summary: Current main still shared each layer's Marlin cross-CTA workspace across concurrent PDMux streams and also retained two stale Scheduler field references. Applied the issue-specific per-stream workspace correction from upstream PR 37905, made the GPU boundary test portable to ROCm, and extended the same workspace isolation to the active GPTQ-Marlin and AWQ-Marlin hardware-backend paths found during the source audit. The selector and sizing behavior were verified on the assigned gfx950 GPU. The reported NVIDIA green-context/Marlin deadlock itself could not be reproduced or executed on this AMD host, so this is a verified candidate rather than a claim of full service-level reproduction.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before source evidence: the base revision had no per-stream Marlin workspace helper; fp8.py passed layer.workspace directly.

Four regression/boundary cases passed: non-PDMux identity fallback, disabled-PDMux no-op, enabled-PDMux initialization/kwargs, and two-real-stream workspace isolation plus max_blocks_per_sm sizing on gfx950. The NVIDIA-only Marlin deep-queue kernel case was explicitly skipped on ROCm. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-baade443d19f/marlin_workspace_pdmux_final.log

On AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950, ROCm 7.2, 256 CUs), two torch GPU streams received different allocations, each 1024 int32 elements for max_blocks_per_sm=4. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-baade443d19f/gfx950_workspace_probe.log
Existing FP8-Marlin logical output/bias-order regression remained passing.
Syntax/import compilation of the changed helper, added backend wiring, and regression test.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 executed the two-stream workspace allocation/isolation and sizing test. It did not execute NVIDIA Marlin kernels or CUDA green contexts.

remaining_limitations: The reported failure requires NVIDIA A100/H100 green-context PDMux plus Marlin; the assigned gfx950 ROCm GPU cannot reproduce that device-side kernel deadlock.
The Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 checkpoint and an NVIDIA GPU with at least 40 GB were unavailable, so test/manual/quant/test_pdmux_mixed_deadlock_repro.py was not run here.
The NVIDIA-only two-stream deep-queue Marlin numerical regression remains unverified locally and was skipped explicitly on ROCm.
No full-model, semantic-accuracy, multi-node, or serving-throughput claim is made.
No native rebuild was required because the change is Python-only.
